subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about scaling paid subscribers for {Brand}. Adapty's 2026 Apple Ads read puts the US download CPA at $2.51, with productivity tools spread wide, AI apps near $2.32 and PDF readers at $4.31, so the band you live in depends entirely on which paywall converts. That is exactly where validated paid events and incrementality decide your real cost per subscriber. We hold out a control group so paid subscribers show as added to your organic base. Worth comparing against your current mix?
